messages.author: 15d2d8f2bea2690f
messages.subject: Cannot compile any models anymore after updating to 2.8.0
parts:
Cannot compile any models anymore after updating RStan to 2.8.0. I am trying to recompile previous models and I get this error message when I try:

Error in if (nchar(check) == 0) { : argument is of length zero
In addition: Warning message:
running command ''/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' CMD config CXX 2>/dev/null' had status 69

Any ideas of what could be going wrong?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Cannot compile any models anymore after updating to 2.8.0
parts:
On Tuesday, September 22, 2015 at 8:51:46 AM UTC-4, Luis Usier wrote:
Also, I've noticed that there are no messages on the console when compiling models now. It used to be really verbose before. Is that by design? I kind of miss having at least some feedback that indicated the model has actually been recompiled.

It is by design. If there are any C++ exceptions, it should say at the end something to the effect of

The following numerical problems occured the indicated number of times on chain 2
                                                                                                     count
Exception thrown at line 11: inv_wishart_log: LDLT_Factor of random variable is not positive definit     2
If this warning occurs sporadically, such as for highly constrained variable types like covariance matrices, then the sampler is fine,but if this warning occurs often then your model may be either severely ill-conditioned or misspecified.

which I got from doing

stan_demo("inv_wishart")

Ben
